def sharpe(a):
    a=np.asarray(a,dtype=float); sd=a.std(ddof=1)
    return float(a.mean()/sd*np.sqrt(ANNUAL_BARS)) if sd>0 else np.nan

def metrics(a):
    a=np.asarray(a,dtype=float)
    wealth=np.cumprod(1+a)
    dd=wealth/np.maximum.accumulate(np.r_[1.,wealth])[1:]-1
    return {'n':len(a),'sharpe':sharpe(a),'cum_return':float(wealth[-1]-1),'max_drawdown':float(dd.min()),'mean_bar':float(a.mean())}

def moving_block_indices(n,block,b,rng):
    k=int(np.ceil(n/block)); starts=rng.integers(0,n-block+1,size=(b,k))
    return (starts[:,:,None]+np.arange(block)).reshape(b,-1)[:,:n]

def dsr_approx(a,n_trials):
    a=np.asarray(a,dtype=float); n=len(a)
    sr=float(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1))
    gamma=float(skew(a,bias=False)); kappa=float(kurtosis(a,fisher=False,bias=False))
    euler=.5772156649015329
    if n_trials<=1: expected=0.
    else:
        expected=(1-euler)*norm.ppf(1-1/n_trials)+euler*norm.ppf(1-1/(n_trials*math.e))
    variance_factor=1-gamma*sr+(kappa-1)*sr*sr/4
    assert variance_factor>0
    z=(sr-expected)*np.sqrt(n-1)/np.sqrt(variance_factor)
    return {'effective_trials_assumed':n_trials,'observed_annual_sharpe':sr*np.sqrt(ANNUAL_BARS),
            'expected_max_null_annual_sharpe':expected*np.sqrt(ANNUAL_BARS),'dsr_probability':float(norm.cdf(z)),
            'sample_skew':gamma,'sample_excess_kurtosis':kappa-3}
